items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Or was it Hilma Burt? I forget. ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's it. Next door.

ctx.x: Huh? You were in the saloon? No, her house was next door to the saloon. Yes, Saloon.
That's the big house. Was that Gertrude Dix's at first and then did Josie Arlington buy it later? What was that? Or was it Hilma Burt? I forget. This is Anderson's place on the corner.
